answer_space.basis: distinct values of a + b - c for a,b in 1..20, c in 1..(a+b)

digest_of: sha256(json.dumps(grammar, sort_keys=True, separators=(", ", ": "), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")) -- subject is the "grammar" object only, not the document, not the file bytes.
generator: Alice has a apples. She buys b more, then gives away c. How many does she have? a,b in 1..20, c in 1..(a+b); answer = a + b - c.

grammar.A_basis: distinct values of a + b - c for a,b in 1..20, c in 1..(a+b) = 40 distinct answers (0..39)
grammar.answer_form_note: canonical: bare decimal digits, no sign, no spaces, no prose, no units; range 0..39
grammar.identity: Alice has 2 apples. She buys 3 more, then gives away 1. How many does she have? = 4
grammar.rule: Q(a, b, c) = 'Alice has a apples. She buys b more, then gives away c. How many does she have?' with a, b in 1..20, c in 1..(a+b); answer = a + b - c (non-negative)

oracle: deterministic: answer == a + b - c; canonical form ^(0|[1-9]|[1-3][0-9])$; malformed if non-canonical.
purpose: Frozen grammar for STUMP (word_prob-v1). Digest is canonical_grammar_digest(grammar).

tie_rule.note: ties split 50/50; with A=40,n=5 a 60% entrant misses the 1% bar by 0.011; at n=30 the coin is negligible.
